description:
v74 (2026-05-23) — Mohit + Parth feedback. Surfaces opening name + idea on early opening moves that R13 (central-pawn) doesn't cover — e.g. m2 d6 in Philidor, m2 Nf3 development. Falls between R13 (m1-m2 central pawns) and R_PROMOTED_opening (≥3 matched setup steps). Authored intros live in services/game_decryption_v5_service.py's get_opening_introduction map.

v88 (2026-05-25) — Mohit on m3 Nc3 in Scandinavian: "this is one of the most played moves at the top level, that gives them teaching about theory and things to remember." New variants consume opening_theory_* facts populated by services/opening_theory_lookup.py when the post-move FEN matches a critical position in data/coaching/opening_theory_tree.json. The lookup applies a pre-commit filter (move1_/move2_/move3_ transposition hints excluded). Three match qualities: 'best' (played move is catalogued main line — praise + idea + why_good), 'mistake' (played move is catalogued mistake — why_bad + consequence + learning), 'critical_only' (position is named but played move not catalogued — show key_decision + top canonical move).

fact_glossary.opening_intro_name: Optional named opening for the move (e.g. 'Philidor-style setup'). v74 source.
fact_glossary.opening_intro_idea: One-sentence idea — the WHY behind the move in this opening. v74 source.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_name: v88 — opening name from theory_tree match (e.g. 'Scandinavian Defense'). Always present when any opening_theory_* fact is present.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_variation: v88 — variation name from theory_tree (e.g. 'Main Line (Qxd5)'). May be None for top-level positions.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_key_decision: v88 — the question the position is asking ('The queen must move - where?').
fact_glossary.opening_theory_played_idea: v88 — when match_quality='best', the idea of the played move from best_moves.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_played_why_good: v88 — why this best move is good.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_played_why_bad: v88 — when match_quality='mistake', why the played move is bad.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_played_consequence: v88 — concrete consequence the player should expect.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_played_learning: v88 — the takeaway lesson from this mistake.
fact_glossary.opening_theory_top_move_san: v88 — canonical top move from best_moves (used when match_quality='critical_only').
fact_glossary.opening_theory_top_move_idea: v88 — idea of the top canonical move.
